reason: A is more mechanistically grounded and testable: it proposes explicit force-constant and distortion descriptors, defines a constrained domain, compares against a baseline on controlled compositions, and includes direct structural and transport measurements. Its 20% threshold is not evidence-derived and it somewhat conflates metallic HEAs with high-entropy ceramics, but B is less well supported, relies partly on mixing entropy as an indirect descriptor, and has a weaker, potentially selection-biased benchmark.
